headline: Microsoft's October Patch Tuesday fixes over 1,400 flaws, ends Windows 11 24H2 support
summary: Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday delivered Windows 11 and Windows 10 cumulative and extended-security updates, with BleepingComputer counting 1,411 flaws and 3 zero-days and ZDNet reporting about 1,400 bugs and 2 zero-days. The release also marked the first official Windows 11 26H2 update and the end of support for Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro editions.
